caption: The drawing depicts two figures of girls, both dressed in period clothing. The main, larger figure is centered, featuring a girl with curly blonde hair adorned with a blue ribbon bow. She wears a long, white dress with lace trim and blue embroidery at the collar, cuffs, and bottom hem. The dress has a wide, flared skirt, and she wears blue shoes with bows. She is accessorized with blue earrings, a blue brooch on her waistband, and holds a large gold ornament with a cross and circular motif on a chain in her left hand. Her cheeks are rosy, and she has blue eyes. In the upper left corner of the drawing, a smaller figure is shown in a brown coat with bright pink cuffs, collar, and hat, over a light dress with lace trim at the bottom, and she also wears blue shoes. The drawing is rendered in delicate lines and soft colors with a focus on blue, white, brown, and pink. The artist’s signature, "Edith Downes," appears in blue in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll - "Retta Hervey"
